findings_addressed: M1 (panel blocked by the page's own CSP): panel-model.ts isPanelFrameBlock + watchFrameBlock (document 'securitypolicyviolation'; frame-src/child-src/default-src on the panel origin; only the origin of blockedURI is compared, the ticket is never kept). Reload the page, then open this tab again' + 'Reload this page' button -> location.reload()); Open full client stays; the useless mint Reload is hidden while blocked. Warn-ahead: http.ts remembers the first GET /panels of the page load (recordPanelsAtLoad/panelsSeenAtLoad); a panel not enabled+listening in it shows the same notice at once and mints no ticket (cspListedAtLoad). Tests: event predicate on Chrome's real shape, watcher on a real EventTarget (fires once, only for the panel origin, unsubscribes), warn-ahead rendering of PanelTab, first-list-wins in http. The event shape (effectiveDirective frame-src, origin-only blockedURI, fired at #document) was verified in headless Chrome against a stand-alone page with a frame-src-less CSP.

m1 (restore-pending never fires / copy contradicts s15): lib/api/fabric.ts restoreFloor() reads FabricStore.restore_pending (tri-state true/false/null); messaging-model restoreState() = pending | clear | unknown, old signals (fabric row reason, queued restore_pending message) still count as pending and win; page says 'This node did not report whether a restore is waiting' instead of 'Nothing is waiting' when absent. RESTORE_HELP / RESTORE_PENDING_TEXT reworded to the s15 as-built (new messages refused, outbox ones wait queued). The mock store reports restore_pending:false. Tests incl. the page rendering unknown / clear / pending from the store alone.

(not when the person dismissed it themselves; not before the post-mint refresh landed). Transition table tested.

m4 (same-origin guard rests on the daemon): ticketSrc now takes the PanelEnv and refuses a port outside 11190-11229, a non-integer port, and a port equal to the dashboard's effective port (dashboardPort, scheme default when the address bar shows none). Tests added.

m5 (mint reply shape): checkMintReply requires a non-empty string url (else bad_url), clampExpiresIn gives a whole number 1..300 (30 when absent/non-numeric), fresh() calls deps.onError on a failed mint (a 401 from Open full client now reaches pairing) and throws a typed PanelUrlError (classified bad_url) for an unframeable reply. ticketSrc also takes unknown input. m7 (prune / store-full copy): STORE_PRUNE_TEXT and STORE_FULL_TEXT now list undelivered messages, mail held for members, pending requests, pinned items and contacts (all contacts), per s10.4 (4). Test added.

Both recorded in interface/README.md (as-built notes for the Panel tab, Nearby, Messages, Settings).

m9 (Nearby): heardText/heardLine say 'clock ahead of this node' for a hint more than 60 s in this node's future (never 'just now'); nearbyState marks the list last-known for a starting service (STARTING_STALE_TEXT). Tests incl. a page render via real services/nearby frames.

m10 (stale hub card): pure applyEnrollText / editEnrollAddress drive EnrollForm: a bare code drops the card, a second whole text replaces card+code and never keeps the first hub's address, editing the address after a whole text drops the card and says so. Tests added.

m11 (tests): ticketSrc vectors added (userinfo-before-host, protocol-relative, backslash and mixed-slash forms, https<->http rebuild, non-string url, port equal to dashboard port, range); the 'not a url' case now pins the exact result; one full pre-U2 setup prompt and one fix prompt pinned as literals computed from lib/prompts.ts at 282bff8^; hostile text injected through service.reason, detail.board, detail.firmware_version, panel title/secure_note and status alias (goal sentences stay clean, panel prose absent, subject one line); a crate-generated 111HUB vector (id111 announce -> mesh111 card_text -> HubBundle::text, via a scratch crate outside the repo) for IPv4, IPv6 and empty-address; the CSP branch tested.

carried (mock enroll bundle 111HUB:<card>:<code>:<address>): mock/messaging.ts exports hubBundleText() (round-trips through parseEnrollBundle and equals the crate vector). NOT wired into the mock adapter: the call site is mock/index.ts line ~925, outside my ownership - see deviations.

carried (cancel control in the thread view): messages cancel route in http.ts (POST /messages/{id}/cancel, reply not read), Adapter.messages.cancel? (optional), isCancellable/isCancelled/CANCELLED in lib/api/messages.ts (isRetryable now false for a cancelled message), thread.tsx 'cancel sending' with a two-step confirm shown only where the adapter has cancel and only for own queued, non-cancelled messages; a cancelled message reads 'cancelled' (glyph word, tooltip, details, reason line REASON_COPY.cancelled) and offers neither cancel nor retry; a 409 shows the node's own words under the conversation. Tests: model tables, MessageRow markup, http route + 409, contract table entry (conditional on the operation, and it ran: the regen landed during the bounce).
deviations: mock/index.ts was NOT edited (ownership). Two carried items need it, and without them the mock keeps emitting 111enroll: and the cancel control is hidden in mock mode (detected via the optional Adapter.messages.cancel). Ready-made wiring for the lead: (a) import { cancelQueued, hubBundleText } from './messaging' and at offerHub (~line 925) use `bundle: cardFor(hubBundleText(M.card.text, code, address))`; (b) add after `retry`: `cancel: (id: string) => rest((): void => { const m = messageById(id); if (cancelQueued(m) !== 'cancelled') throw problem(409, 'bad_request', 'Not cancellable', 'Only an own message that is still queued can be cancelled.'); publishMessage(m, 'state'); }),` and add `if (m.reason_code === 'cancelled') return;` at the top of dispatch() so the retry/reevaluate chain does not overwrite the reason; (c) fabric.patchSettings: keep a cleared quota as `quotas[k] = null` instead of `delete quotas[k]` (the daemon keeps the class with null; otherwise a cleared row vanishes from the editor in mock mode), then the messaging-mock quota test can assert null exactly. With (b) done, Adapter.messages.cancel can become required.

Adapter.messages.cancel is optional on the type and typed without referencing generated types (explicit path, as the brief allowed). By the time I finished, F2-bounce's regen had landed (types.gen.ts has cancelMessage -> 202 Message and FabricStore.restore_pending?: boolean) and everything still compiles; the wrapper does not read the reply body. The http contract-table test adds its cancelMessage entry only when the operation exists, so it passes before and after the regen.

The first-GET /panels memory (recordPanelsAtLoad/panelsSeenAtLoad/resetPanelsAtLoadForTests) lives in lib/api/http.ts, which goes beyond 'additive: cancel + restore_pending'. It is the only owned eager module that sees the page's first GET /panels; the store (not mine) would be the more natural home. The mock adapter does not record it, so the warn-ahead is real-adapter only (the reactive branch needs nothing).

The headless-Chrome check the reviewer asked for was run against a stand-alone two-port page with the same CSP shape (no frame-src), not against a real 111d in the exact set-up order; that end-to-end run belongs to V1. What it did confirm is the event shape the fix depends on.

The Reload (new ticket) button is hidden while the page's policy blocks the frame, which the triage did not specify: a new ticket cannot get past a document's CSP, so the button would only mint into a blocked frame.
result.notes:
For the reviewer:
- The real-daemon risk to watch in V1: the thread view shows 'cancel sending' for every own queued message on the http adapter. If the UI lands before F2's route, the click errors with the node's own words (404/405) rather than hiding the control.
- Thread-list aggregates (Thread.states.queued, 'N queued') still count a cancelled message as queued; that is the daemon's aggregate, so C1/F2 may want to exclude reason_code=cancelled.
- Outside my files, observed: lib/prompts.ts puts service.detail into the 'subject:' JSON line with raw U+202E/U+2066 (JSON.stringify does not escape them), so a radio-reported board name could reorder what the person sees in the editable Agent textarea. The goal sentences are clean (now tested); the subject line is not. A one-line cleanDeep() in compactService would fix it.
- Pre-existing quirk left alone: the enroll paste box reads any text of 12 characters or fewer with 8+ letters/digits (for example 'hello there') as a bare code, because normalizeCode truncates to 8. With the new card-dropping rule this also drops a card; it is harmless but a stricter bare-code test (exactly 8 alphanumerics after removing dashes and spaces) would be better.
- A page reload after the CSP notice returns to the Details tab (tab state is local); the copy says 'then open this tab again'.
- Owner questions unchanged by this bounce: P1 listing every declared panel slot in frame-src (a s13 amendment) would remove the need for the reload notice; /settings/l5 in Simple mode amends README 6.7; Identify has no UI path.
- I did not touch interface/verify/** or test/tapes/**, and ran no git write command. Scratch work (golden prompt generator, the vecgen crate that produced the crate vectors, the CSP probe) is under the scratchpad and /tmp/claude-1000/u2-bounce-target, not in the repo.
